Done — one execution, no failures.

**Approach:** plain `torch` + `safetensors`, with `huggingface_hub.split_torch_state_dict_into_shards` for the shard layout. I skipped `transformers.save_pretrained` because it applies a single global dtype and can't express a per-tensor precision split.

**Result in `out/T3/`:** 4 shards + `model.safetensors.index.json`, 148 tensors, 48 bfloat16.

| shard | tensors | data bytes | ≤64 MiB |
|---|---|---|---|
| 00001 | 59 | 66,259,968 | yes |
| 00002 | 58 | 66,256,896 | yes |
| 00003 | 1 (`wte.weight`) | 154,389,504 | alone, exempt |
| 00004 | 30 | 40,983,552 | yes |

Key details: the projection regex is anchored to exactly the four matrices per layer so it can't reach `wte`/`wpe`/layer norms; the 12 `h.<i>.attn.bias` mask buffers are matched explicitly and dropped, with an assertion that *only* those 12 keys disappeared. All four required checks are asserted before any file is written, plus a post-write shard-budget and weight-map check.
